beats.event: Ninth year of the Trojan War; Achaean camp; plague from Apollo
Agamemnon seizes Briseis from Achilles as compensation
Achilles withdraws; Thetis begs Zeus to favor the Trojans
Duel of Paris and Menelaus decides nothing; truce is broken
Diomedes rages across the field, even wounds Aphrodite
Embassy offers Briseis and gifts back; Achilles refuses
Trojans drive the Achaeans back to their ships
Patroclus dons Achilles's armor and leads the Myrmidons out
Hector kills Patroclus outside the walls of Troy
Achilles hears the news; grief overwhelms him; he vows vengeance
Hephaestus forges Achilles's new armor and shield
Achilles rejoins the battle, clogs the Scamander with dead
Achilles kills Hector in single combat before Troy
Achilles drags Hector's body around the walls of Troy
Funeral games for Patroclus; Achilles distributes the prizes
Priam ransoms Hector's body; Achilles weeps and relents
